blocks.text: Miss Universe Philippines 2022 Celeste Cortesi has officially welcomed motherhood as she announced the arrival of her firstborn, baby boy Sergio. Cortesi made the announcement through her Instagram page on Tuesday, Oct. 27, sharing a glimpse of her newborn sleeping soundly in her arm. “So precious, Baby S,” she wrote in the caption. Sergio’s dad and Cortesi’s former partner, businessman Jonathan Sterling, reshared the beauty queen’s post and expressed his admiration for her. “So proud of Celeste and how far she’s come on her journey.
